verses.text: E happen, as e dey pray for one place, when e finish, one of im disciples talk to am say, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John teach im disciples too.”
E talk to dem say, “When una dey pray, talk say, ‘Our Papa God for heaven, make your name dey holy. Make your Kingdom come. Make your will happen for earth, as e dey happen for heaven.
Give us our daily bread every day.
Forgive us our sins, because we too dey forgive everybody wey owe us. No lead us enter temptation, but save us from di evil one.’”
E talk to dem say, “Which of una, if una go meet friend for midnight, tell am, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
because my friend don come meet me from journey, and I no get anything to put before am,’
and e answer from inside talk say, ‘No disturb me. Di door don lock now, and my pikin dem dey bed with me. I no fit get up give you’?
I dey tell una, even if e no go get up give am because e be im friend, because of im persistence, e go get up give am as many as e need.
I dey tell una, keep asking, and dem go give una. Keep seeking, and una go find. Keep knocking, and dem go open for una.
Because everybody wey ask dey receive. Di person wey seek dey find. To di person wey knock, dem go open.
Which of una papa dem, if im son ask for bread, go give am stone? Or if e ask for fish, e go give am snake instead of fish?
Or if e ask for egg, e go give am scorpion?
If una wey be evil know how to give good gifts to una pikin dem, how much more una Papa God wey dey heaven go give Holy Spirit to di people wey ask am?”
E dey drive out one evil spirit wey make person no fit talk. E happen, when di evil spirit don go out, di man wey no fit talk talk; and di crowds marvel.
But some of dem talk say, “Na by Beelzebul, di prince of di evil spirits, e dey drive out evil spirits.”
Others dey test am, dey ask am for sign from heaven.
But e know dem thoughts, talk to dem say, “Every kingdom wey divide against imself go dey destroyed, and house wey divide against imself go fall.
If Satan too don divide against imself, how im kingdom go stand? Because una dey talk say na by Beelzebul I dey drive out evil spirits.
But if na by Beelzebul I dey drive out evil spirits, na by who una pikin dem dey drive dem out? So dem go be una judges.
But if na by God finger I dey drive out evil spirits, den God Kingdom don come to una.
When strong man wey get full weapon dey guard im own house, im goods dey safe.
But when somebody wey strong pass attack am and overcome am, e go take all im armor wey e trust, and share im plunder.
Anybody wey no dey with me dey against me. Anybody wey no gather with me dey scatter.
Di evil spirit, when e don go out of di man, e dey pass through places wey no get water dey look for rest, and as e no find any, e dey talk say, ‘I go turn back to my house wey I come out from.’
When e return, e find am swept and arranged.
Den e go, take seven other spirits wey evil pass am, and dem enter dey live there. Di last condition of that man go worse pass di first.”
E happen as e dey talk these things, one woman for di crowd raise im voice, talk to am say, “Blessed be di womb wey carry you, and di breasts wey you suck!”
But e talk say, “No be so, blessed be di people wey hear God word, and keep am.”
As di crowds dey gather to am, e begin talk say, “This generation na evil generation. E dey look for sign. Dem no go give am any sign except di sign of Jonah, di prophet.
Because just as Jonah become sign to di Ninevites, so di Son of Man go be to this generation.

Di queen of di south go rise for di judgment with di men of this generation, and go condemn dem: because e come from di ends of di earth to hear Solomon wisdom; and look, somebody greater than Solomon dey here.
Di men of Nineveh go stand up for di judgment with this generation, and go condemn am, because dem repent when Jonah preach; and look, somebody greater than Jonah dey here.
Nobody, when e don light lamp, dey put am for cellar or under basket, but on stand, so that di people wey enter go see di light.
Di lamp of di body na di eye. So when your eye good, your whole body full of light too; but when e bad, your body full of darkness too.
So check say di light wey dey inside you no be darkness.
If your whole body full of light, no part dark, e go full of light well, like when lamp shine bright for you.”
Now as e dey talk, one Pharisee invite am to chop with am. E enter, sit for table.
When di Pharisee see am, e marvel say e no first wash before chop.
Lord talk to am say, “Now una Pharisees dey clean di outside of di cup and of di plate, but una inside full of greed and wickedness.
Una foolish ones, no be di one wey make di outside make di inside too?
But give gifts to di needy from inside, and look, everything go clean for una.

But sorrow dey for una Pharisees! Because una dey give tithe of mint and rue and every herb, but una dey ignore justice and di love of God. Una suppose do these ones, and no leave di other ones undone.
Sorrow dey for una Pharisees! Because una love di best seats for di synagogues, and di greetings for di marketplaces.
Sorrow dey for una, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because una be like graves wey nobody mark, and di men wey dey waka on dem no know.”
One of di lawyers answer am, “Teacher, as you dey talk this, you dey insult us too.”
E talk say, “Sorrow dey for una lawyers too! Because una dey load men with burdens wey hard to carry, but una yourself no go even use one finger help carry those burdens.
Sorrow dey for una! Because una dey build di tombs of di prophets, and una papa dem kill dem.
So una dey testify and agree with wetin una papa dem do. Because dem kill dem, and una dey build dem tombs.
So di wisdom of God talk too, ‘I go send prophets and apostles to dem; and some of dem dem go kill and persecute,
so that dem go demand di blood of all di prophets, wey dem shed from di foundation of di world, from this generation,
from di blood of Abel to di blood of Zachariah, wey die between di altar and di sanctuary.’ Yes, I dey tell una, dem go demand am from this generation.
Sorrow dey for una lawyers! Because una take away di key of knowledge. Una no enter yourself, and di people wey dey enter, una stop dem.”
As e dey talk these things to dem, di scribes and di Pharisees begin vex well well, and dey try draw plenty things from am;
dey wait for am, dey try catch am for something wey e go talk, so that dem go accuse am.
Meanwhile, when many thousands of people don gather, so tay dem dey step on each other, e begin talk to im disciples first of all, “Beware of di yeast of di Pharisees, wey be hypocrisy.
But nothing dey covered wey dem no go reveal, and nothing dey hidden wey dem no go know.
So anything wey una talk for darkness go dey heard for light. Wetin una talk for ear for inner rooms go dey announce for housetops.
I dey tell una, my friends, no fear di people wey dey kill di body, and after that no get anything more wey dem fit do.
But I go warn una who una suppose fear. Fear di one wey, after e don kill, get power to throw inside Gehenna. Yes, I dey tell una, fear am.
No be five sparrows dem dey sell for two small coins? But God no forget even one of dem.
But even di hairs of your head dem don count all. So no fear. Una worth pass plenty sparrows.
I dey tell una, everybody wey confess me before men, di Son of Man go confess am too before di angels of God;
but di one wey deny me before men, dem go deny am before di angels of God.
Everybody wey talk word against di Son of Man, dem go forgive am, but di one wey blaspheme against di Holy Spirit, dem no go forgive am.
When dem bring una before di synagogues, di rulers, and di authorities, no worry how or wetin una go answer, or wetin una go talk;
because Holy Spirit go teach una for that same hour wetin una must talk.”
One person for di crowd talk to am say, “Teacher, tell my brother make e share di inheritance with me.”
But e talk to am say, “My friend, who make me judge or arbitrator over una?”
E talk to dem say, “Beware! Guard yourselves from greed, because man life no dey depend on di plenty things wey e get.”
E tell dem parable, say, “One rich man land produce plenty.
E dey reason inside imself, say, ‘Wetin I go do, because I no get place to keep my crops?’
E talk say, ‘Na this I go do. I go pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and for there I go keep all my grain and my goods.
I go talk to my soul say, Soul, you get plenty goods wey dem don keep for many years. Rest, chop, drink, enjoy.’
But God talk to am say, ‘You foolish one, tonight dem go demand your soul from you. Di things wey you don prepare—na who own go dem be?’
So e be for di person wey dey store treasure for imself, and no rich before God.”
E talk to im disciples say, “So I dey tell una, no worry about una life, wetin una go chop, or about una body, wetin una go wear.
Life pass food, and di body pass clothing.
Look di ravens: dem no dey plant, dem no dey harvest, dem no get store room or barn, and God dey feed dem. Una worth pass di birds well well!
Which of una, by worrying, fit add one cubit to im height?
If una no fit do even di smallest things, why una dey worry about di rest?
Look di lilies, how dem dey grow. Dem no dey work hard, dem no dey spin, but I dey tell una, even Solomon for all im glory no dress like one of these.
But if na so God dey cloth di grass for di field, wey dey today, and tomorrow dem go throw am inside oven, how much more e go cloth una, una wey get small faith?
No look for wetin una go chop or wetin una go drink; and no worry.
Because di nations of di world dey look for all these things, but una Papa God know say una need these things.
But look for God Kingdom, and dem go add all these things to una.
No fear, small flock, because na una Papa God pleasure to give una di Kingdom.
Sell wetin una get, give gifts to di needy. Make purses for yourselves wey no dey old, treasure for di heavens wey no dey fail, wia thief no dey near, and moth no dey destroy.
Because wia your treasure dey, na there your heart go dey too.
Make una dey ready and una lamps dey burn.
Be like men wey dey wait for dem oga, when e dey return from di wedding feast; so that when e come knock, dem go open for am at once.
Blessed be those servants wey di oga go find dey watch when e come. Na true I dey tell una, e go dress imself, make dem sit for table, and come serve dem.
If e come for di second or third watch, and find dem so, blessed be those servants.
But know this, say if oga of di house know wetin hour di thief go come, e go don watch, and e no go allow dem break enter im house.
So una too make una ready, because di Son of Man dey come for hour wey una no expect.”
Peter talk to am say, “Lord, na to us you dey tell this parable, or to everybody?”
Lord talk say, “Who then be di faithful and wise manager, wey im oga go put over im household, to give dem dem food portion for di right time?
Blessed be that servant wey im oga go find dey do so when e come.
Na true I dey tell una, e go put am over everything wey e get.
But if that servant talk for im heart say, ‘My oga dey delay to come,’ and begin beat di menservants and di maidservants, and dey chop and drink and dey drunk,
di oga of that servant go come for day wey e no expect am, and for hour wey e no know, and go cut am for two, and put am with di unfaithful.
That servant, wey know im oga will, and no prepare, and no do wetin e want, dem go beat am with many stripes,

but di one wey no know, and do things wey deserve stripes, dem go beat am with few stripes. Anybody wey dem give plenty, dem go demand plenty from am; and di one wey dem trust with plenty, dem go ask more from am.
I come to throw fire on di earth. I wish say e don already dey burn.
But I get baptism wey dem go baptize me with, and how I dey distressed until e finish!
Una think say I come to give peace for di earth? I dey tell una, no, but division.
Because from now, five go dey for one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
Dem go divide, papa against son, and son against papa; mama against daughter, and daughter against im mama; mother-in-law against im daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against im mother-in-law.”
E talk to di crowds too, “When una see cloud dey rise for west, at once una dey talk say, ‘Rain dey come,’ and e dey happen.
When south wind blow, una dey talk say, ‘Hot weather go dey,’ and e dey happen.
Una hypocrites! Una know how to interpret di look of di earth and di sky, but how e be say una no dey interpret this time?
Why una no dey judge for yourselves wetin right?

Because when you dey go with your opponent before di magistrate, try well for di way make e release you, so that e no go drag you go di judge, and di judge no go deliver you to di officer, and di officer no go throw you inside prison.
I dey tell you, you no go ever leave there, until you don pay di very last coin.”
Now some people dey there for that same time wey tell am about di Galileans, wey Pilate mix dem blood with dem sacrifices.
Jesus answer dem, “Una think say these Galileans na worse sinners pass all di Galileans, because dem suffer such things?
I dey tell una, no, but unless una repent, una all go perish for di same way.
Or those 18 wey di tower for Siloam fall on, kill dem; una think say dem na worse offenders pass all di men wey dey live for Jerusalem?
I dey tell una, no, but unless una repent, una all go perish for di same way.”
E tell this parable. “One man get fig tree wey dem plant for im vineyard, and e come dey look for fruit on am, and e no find any.
E talk to di vine keeper say, ‘Look, these three years I dey come look for fruit on this fig tree, and I no find any. Cut am down. Why e dey waste di soil?’
E answer, ‘Oga, leave am this year too, until I dig round am, and put fertilizer.
If e bear fruit, e good; but if no, after that, you fit cut am down.’”
E dey teach for one of di synagogues for Sabbath day.
Look, one woman dey wey get spirit of sickness for 18 years, and e bend, and e no fit straighten up at all.
When Jesus see am, e call am, talk to am say, “Woman, dem don free you from your sickness.”
E put hands on am, and at once e stand up straight, dey praise God.
Di ruler of di synagogue vex because Jesus heal for Sabbath, talk to di crowd say, “Six days dey wey men suppose work. So come for those days make dem heal una, no be for Sabbath day!”
So Lord answer am, “Una hypocrites! No be each one of una dey free im ox or im donkey from di stall for Sabbath, lead am go drink water?
Suppose this woman, wey be Abraham daughter, wey Satan don tie for 18 long years, no free from this bondage for Sabbath day?”
As e dey talk these things, all im enemies shame, and all di crowd rejoice for all di glorious things wey e do.
E talk say, “Wetin God Kingdom be like? To wetin I go compare am?
E be like mustard seed, wey one man take, plant for im own garden. E grow, become big tree, and birds of di sky dey rest for im branches.”
Again e talk say, “To wetin I go compare God Kingdom?
E be like yeast, wey one woman take hide for three measures of flour, until all of am rise.”
E dey go im way through towns and villages, dey teach, dey travel towards Jerusalem.
One person talk to am say, “Lord, na few people dey saved?” E talk to dem say,
“Try hard to enter through di narrow door, because plenty, I dey tell una, go try to enter, and dem no go fit.

When oga of di house don get up, lock di door, and una begin stand outside, dey knock for di door, dey talk say, ‘Lord, Lord, open for us!’ den e go answer tell una, ‘I no know una or wia una come from.’
Den una go begin talk say, ‘We chop and drink with you, and you teach for our streets.’
E go talk say, ‘I dey tell una, I no know wia una come from. Go from me, all una wey dey do evil.’
Crying and grinding of teeth go dey, when una see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all di prophets for God Kingdom, and una dey throw outside.
Dem go come from east, west, north, and south, and go sit down for God Kingdom.
Look, some dey wey be last wey go be first, and some dey wey be first wey go be last.”
For that same day, some Pharisees come, talk to am say, “Leave here, go away, because Herod want kill you.”
E talk to dem say, “Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I dey drive out evil spirits and dey heal today and tomorrow, and for di third day I go finish my work.
But I must go my way today, tomorrow, and di next day, because e no fit be say prophet go die outside Jerusalem.’

Jerusalem, Jerusalem, wey dey kill di prophets, and dey throw stones for di people wey dem send to am! How many times I want gather your pikin dem together, like hen wey dey gather im chicks under im wings, and una refuse!
Look, dem don leave your house for una desolate. I dey tell una, una no go see me again, until una talk say, ‘Blessed be di one wey dey come for di name of di Lord!’”
E happen, when e enter di house of one of di rulers of di Pharisees for Sabbath to chop, say dem dey watch am.
Look, one man dey before am wey get sickness wey make body swell with water.
Jesus answer di lawyers and Pharisees, talk say, “Di law allow person to heal for Sabbath?”
But dem keep quiet. E take di man, heal am, and let am go.
E answer dem, “Which of una, if im son or ox fall inside well, no go pull am out at once for Sabbath day?”
Dem no fit answer am about these things.
E tell parable to di people wey dem invite, as e notice how dem dey choose di best seats, and talk to dem say,
“When anybody invite you to wedding feast, no sit for di best seat, because perhaps dem don invite somebody wey get more honor pass you,
and di person wey invite una both go come tell you, ‘Give this person place.’ Den you go begin, with shame, take di lowest place.

But when dem invite you, go sit for di lowest place, so that when di person wey invite you come, e go tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Den you go get honor before all di people wey dey sit for table with you.
Because everybody wey lift imself up, dem go humble am, and anybody wey humble imself, dem go lift am up.”

E talk to di one wey invite am too, “When you make dinner or supper, no call your friends, or your brothers, or your relatives, or rich neighbors, because perhaps dem go invite you back, and pay you back.
But when you make feast, invite di poor, di cripple, di lame, or di blind;
and you go blessed, because dem no get wetin to pay you back. Because dem go pay you back for di resurrection of di righteous.”
When one of di people wey dey sit for table with am hear these things, e talk to am say, “Blessed be di person wey go chop for God Kingdom!”
But e talk to am say, “One man make big supper, and e invite plenty people.
E send im servant for supper time to tell di people wey dem invite, ‘Come, because everything don ready now.’
Dem all begin make excuses together. Di first talk to am say, ‘I don buy farm, and I must go see am. I beg you, excuse me.’
Another talk say, ‘I don buy five pairs of oxen, and I must go try dem. I beg you, excuse me.’
Another talk say, ‘I don marry wife, so I no fit come.’

Di servant come tell im oga these things. Den oga of di house, wey vex, talk to im servant say, ‘Go out quick enter di streets and lanes of di town, bring di poor, di cripple, di blind, and di lame come.’
Di servant talk say, ‘Oga, I don do as you command, and space still dey.’
Di oga talk to di servant say, ‘Go out enter di highways and hedges, force dem to come in, so that my house go full.
Because I dey tell una say none of those men wey I invite go taste my supper.’”
Now great crowds dey go with am. E turn talk to dem say,
“If anybody come to me, and no love me pass im own papa, mama, wife, pikin dem, brothers, and sisters, yes, and im own life too, e no fit be my disciple.
Anybody wey no carry im own cross, and follow me, no fit be my disciple.
Because which of una, wey want build tower, no go first sit down count di cost, to see if e get enough to finish am?
Or perhaps, when e don lay foundation, and e no fit finish, all wey see go begin mock am,
dey talk say, ‘This man begin build, and e no fit finish.’
Or which king, as e dey go meet another king for war, no go first sit down think whether e fit with 10,000 meet di one wey dey come against am with 20,000?
If no, while di other one still dey far, e go send envoy, ask for terms of peace.
So anybody among una wey no give up all wetin e get, e no fit be my disciple.
Salt dey good, but if di salt lose im taste, wetin una go take season am?
E no good for soil or for manure pile. Dem throw am out. Anybody wey get ears to hear, make e hear.”
Now all di tax collectors and sinners dey come close to am to hear am.
Di Pharisees and di scribes dey grumble, dey talk say, “This man dey welcome sinners, and dey chop with dem.”
E tell dem this parable.
“Which of una men, if una get 100 sheep, and lose one of dem, no go leave di 99 for di wilderness, go follow di one wey lost, until e find am?
When e don find am, e dey carry am for im shoulders, dey rejoice.
When e reach house, e dey call im friends and im neighbors together, dey talk to dem say, ‘Rejoice with me, because I don find my sheep wey lost!’
I dey tell una say na so joy go dey for heaven over one sinner wey repent, more than over 99 righteous people wey no need repentance.
Or which woman, if e get ten drachma coins, and e lose one drachma coin, no go light lamp, sweep di house, and look well until e find am?
When e don find am, e dey call im friends and neighbors together, dey talk say, ‘Rejoice with me, because I don find di drachma wey I lose.’
Na so, I dey tell una, joy dey before di angels of God over one sinner wey repent.”
E talk say, “One man get two sons.
Di younger one talk to im papa say, ‘Papa, give me my share of your property.’ E divide im living between dem.
No many days after, di younger son gather all of am together, travel go far country. For there e waste im property with wild living.
When e don spend all of am, severe famine rise for that country, and e begin dey need.
E go join one of di citizens of that country, and e send am go im farms to feed pigs.
E want fill im belle with di husks wey di pigs dey chop, but nobody give am any.
But when e come to imself e talk say, ‘How many hired servants of my papa get bread wey plenty, and I dey die with hunger!
I go get up go my papa, and I go tell am say, Papa, I don sin against heaven, and before you.
I no worthy again to dey called your son. Make me be like one of your hired servants.’
E get up, come meet im papa. But as e still dey far, im papa see am, compassion move am, and e run, fall for im neck, and kiss am.
Di son talk to am say, ‘Papa, I don sin against heaven, and before you. I no worthy again to dey called your son.’
But di papa talk to im servants say, ‘Bring out di best robe, put am on am. Put ring for im hand, and sandals for im feet.
Bring di fat calf, kill am, make we chop, and celebrate;
because this my son die, and e alive again. E lost, and dem don find am.’ Dem begin celebrate.
Now im older son dey for di farm. As e near di house, e hear music and dancing.
E call one of di servants come, ask wetin these things mean.
E talk to am say, ‘Your brother don come, and your papa don kill di fat calf, because e receive am back safe and well.’
But e vex, and e no wan enter. So im papa come out, beg am.
But e answer im papa, ‘Look, these many years I don serve you, and I never disobey any of your commandments, but you never give me goat, so that I go celebrate with my friends.
But when this your son come, wey don chop your living with prostitutes, you kill di fat calf for am.’
E talk to am say, ‘Son, you dey with me always, and all wey be mine na your own.
But e suppose to celebrate and dey glad, because this your brother die, and e alive again. E lost, and dem don find am.’”
E talk to im disciples too, “One rich man dey wey get manager. Dem accuse di manager to am say e dey waste im possessions.
E call am, talk to am say, ‘Wetin be this wey I dey hear about you? Give account of your management, because you no fit be manager again.’
Di manager talk inside imself, ‘Wetin I go do, as my oga dey take di management from me? I no get strength to dig. Shame dey catch me to beg.
I know wetin I go do, so that when dem remove me from management, people go receive me for dem houses.’
E call each one of im oga debtors come, talk to di first, ‘How much you owe my oga?’
E talk say, ‘100 batos of oil.’ E talk to am say, ‘Take your bill, sit down quick write 50.’
Den e ask another, ‘How much you owe?’ E talk say, ‘100 cors of wheat.’ E talk to am say, ‘Take your bill, write 80.’
Im oga praise di dishonest manager because e do wisely, because di pikin dem of this world, for dem own generation, wise pass di pikin dem of di light.
I dey tell una, make friends for yourselves with unrighteous mammon, so that when una finish, dem go receive una enter di tents wey no dey end.
Di person wey faithful for very small thing dey faithful for plenty too. Di person wey dey dishonest for very small thing dey dishonest for plenty too.
So if una no faithful with unrighteous mammon, who go trust una with di true riches?
If una no faithful with wetin be another person own, who go give una wetin be una own?
No servant fit serve two masters, because e go hate one and love di other, or e go hold to one and despise di other. Una no fit serve God and Mammon.”
Di Pharisees, wey love money, hear all these things too, and dem mock am.
E talk to dem say, “Una na di ones wey dey justify yourselves before men, but God know una hearts. Because wetin men dey lift up na abomination before God.
Di law and di prophets dey until John. From that time dem dey preach di Good News of God Kingdom, and everybody dey force im way enter am.
But e easy for heaven and earth to pass away, pass for one tiny stroke of pen of di law to fail.
Everybody wey divorce im wife and marry another dey commit adultery. Di person wey marry woman wey don divorce im husband dey commit adultery.
Now one rich man dey, and e dey wear purple and fine linen, dey live for luxury every day.
One beggar, wey im name na Lazarus, dem carry go im gate, full of sores,
dey want make dem feed am with di crumbs wey dey fall from di rich man table. Yes, even di dogs dey come lick im sores.
E happen say di beggar die, and angels carry am go Abraham bosom. Di rich man die too, and dem bury am.
For Hades, e lift up im eyes, as e dey for torment, see Abraham from far, and Lazarus for im bosom.
E shout, talk say, ‘Papa Abraham, show me mercy, send Lazarus, so that e go dip di tip of im finger for water, cool my tongue! Because I dey suffer for this flame.’
But Abraham talk say, ‘Son, remember say for your lifetime you receive your good things, and Lazarus, for di same way, bad things. But now e dey comforted here, and you dey suffer.
Besides all this, between us and una, big gulf dey fixed, so that di people wey want pass from here to una no fit, and nobody fit cross from there come us.’
E talk say, ‘I beg you, Papa, make you send am to my papa house;
because I get five brothers, make e testify to dem, so that dem no go come this place of torment too.’
But Abraham talk to am say, ‘Dem get Moses and di prophets. Make dem listen to dem.’
E talk say, ‘No, Papa Abraham, but if somebody go to dem from di dead, dem go repent.’
E talk to am say, ‘If dem no listen to Moses and di prophets, dem no go dey persuaded even if somebody rise from di dead.’”
